notes.title: Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo first patch
notes.content:
Hey, warriors!

We stand ready to deploy a small patch to improve your gaming experience. The update will become available today, and it’ll be very helpful if you can re-install Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo and try it once again to feel the difference. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41617319/1e329e4a26eadf9f95305a1bb5882c7a4b148527.jpg[/img]

Here's the list of changes:

1. Players can now skip tutorial challenges available in the Dojo (aka the training room).

2. Fixed a bug at the end of the very first boss fight. Some players surprised us with screenshots of a weird-looking 3D model of the boss standing behind Yami during a cutscene at the end of the first boss fight. If you happened to experience it, sweat no more — we found what caused it and fixed it.

3. Uncapped frame rate settings hotfix. Want to take full advantage of your 144Hz monitor? Go to the Settings in Menu and enable the unlimited FPS rate to let the game render as fast as possible. 

4. Improved Heavy Kami's hammer animations. When fighting with Heavy Kami (the big guy with a darn heavy hammer) you could notice that his hammer sometimes didn't match his body posture and moves. We went ahead and changed it so that now his weird body language won't distract you from surviving the fight.  

Hopefully, these changes will make your gaming experience even more pleasant, and also we'd like to thank everyone who filled out a survey form as well as all who left feedback on Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo in Discord, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294880/Blind_Fate_Edo_no_Yami/]Steam[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/_Troglobytes_]Twitter[/url]. Without you, we wouldn’t have found some nasty bugs and come up with some great ideas. There is much more to implement and improve before the launch of the game, and we hope you will stay with us to make Blind Fate: Edo no Yami even better together!

Add Blind Fate: Edo no Yami to your wishlist and subscribe to our news so that you don't miss the upcoming events, updates, and contests.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294880/Blind_Fate_Edo_no_Yami/
